plugins.name: impeccable
scripts: scripts/live-browser.js (local live-edit server, talks to localhost with a token)
plugins.network: Yes: on first hook run it downloads a prebuilt engine binary from github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/releases, checks its SHA-256 against engine-checksums.txt (refuses on mismatch or when no hash tool exists), caches it and executes it on every edit. IMPECCABLE_BIN can point at a binary you built yourself.
plugins.note: Hooks run an unreviewable prebuilt engine with network on every edit; account sign-in upsell, report upload and telemetry; writes hooks into .claude settings after consent; live-mode tool output overrides the skill text.
